title: contracts/ads.json
description: The app's ads facts read by the admob-ads-and-consent checkers (check-ads.mjs, check-ad-behaviour.mjs).

audience.description: general: maxAdContentRating only, no child-directed or under-age tags. child-directed: maxAdContentRating G, tagForChildDirectedTreatment and tagForUnderAgeOfConsent true, Android's AD_ID permission blocked, and no App Tracking Transparency at all (no expo-tracking-transparency, plugin, purpose text or tracking adapter; the consent adapter gets tracking: null; App Review 1.3). Neither covers COPPA, guideline 1.3's limits on third-party ads or the Families policy by itself.

maxAdContentRating.description: The rating the adapter's REQUEST_CONFIGURATION sets, equal to the AdMob console's maximum ad content rating (child-directed: G).

bannerSlots.description: Folder of a screen that shows a banner (ending in /) -> its AdBannerSlot testID '<screen>.banner-ad'.

pacingFloors.description: The lowest pacing numbers src/config/ad-pacing.ts may hold (check-ads rule policy-numbers).

trackingTextKey.description: The catalog key of NSUserTrackingUsageDescription, present in every language's catalog (general audience; a child-directed app has none).
